title: Fly by SkibidiFontan121
script:
--[[
    🕊️ FLY BYPASS v2 | CLEAN UI
    Обход античитов: Physics state + NetworkOwner + BodyVelocity
    Аккуратная вёрстка без слипаний
]]

-- ============================================================
-- 1. СЕРВИСЫ
-- ============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ============================================================
-- 2. ОТКРЫТИЕ DISCORD
-- ============================================================
local DISCORD_URL = "https://discord.gg/ZJWwKbz8c"

local function openDiscord()
    local methods = {
        function() return openbrowser(DISCORD_URL) end,
        function() return openweb(DISCORD_URL) end,
        function() return syn.request({Url = DISCORD_URL, Method = "GET"}) end,
        function() return request({Url = DISCORD_URL, Method = "GET"}) end,
    }
    for _, m in ipairs(methods) do
        if pcall(m) then return true end
    end
    pcall(function()
        setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Discord",
            Text = "Ссылка скопирована в буфер обмена!",
            Duration = 5
        })
    end)
    return false
end

-- ============================================================
-- 3. ЗАГРУЗОЧНЫЙ ЭКРАН
-- ============================================================
local LoadingGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
LoadingGui.Name = "FlyLoader_" .. tostring(math.random(1, 999999))
LoadingGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
LoadingGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
LoadingGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
pcall(function() LoadingGui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not LoadingGui.Parent then
    LoadingGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- Фон
local Backdrop = Instance.new("Frame")
Backdrop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
Backdrop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)

Backdrop.BorderSizePixel = 0

Backdrop.Parent = LoadingGui

-- Окно (высота увеличена чтобы всё влезло с отступами)

MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 480, 0, 380)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
MainFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

MainFrame.Parent = LoadingGui

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

-- Отступы через UIListLayout-like ручную сетку
-- Заголовок (Y=30, высота 40)

Title.Text = "🕊️ FLY BYPASS"

Title.TextSize = 28

Title.TextTransparency = 1
Title.ZIndex = 3
Title.Parent = MainFrame

-- Подзаголовок (Y=75, высота 20)
local SubTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

SubTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 75)
SubTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1

SubTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 165)
SubTitle.TextSize = 14
SubTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
SubTitle.TextTransparency = 1
SubTitle.ZIndex = 3
SubTitle.Parent = MainFrame

-- Разделитель 1 (Y=110)
local Divider1 = Instance.new("Frame")
Divider1.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 1)
Divider1.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 110)
Divider1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70)
Divider1.BorderSizePixel = 0
Divider1.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Divider1.ZIndex = 3

-- Прогресс-бар (Y=140, высота 8)
local ProgressBg = Instance.new("Frame")

local ProgressBgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local ProgressFill = Instance.new("Frame")

-- Текст статуса (Y=165, высота 20)

-- Процент загрузки справа (Y=165, высота 20)

PercentText.TextTransparency = 1
PercentText.ZIndex = 3
PercentText.Parent = MainFrame

-- Разделитель 2 (Y=205)
local Divider2 = Instance.new("Frame")
Divider2.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 1)
Divider2.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 205)
Divider2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70)
Divider2.BorderSizePixel = 0
Divider2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Divider2.ZIndex = 3
Divider2.Parent = MainFrame

-- Текст "Присоединяйся" (Y=225, высота 20)
local JoinText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
JoinText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 20)
JoinText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 225)
JoinText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
JoinText.Text = "Присоединяйся к нашему сообществу:"
JoinText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
JoinText.TextSize = 14
JoinText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
JoinText.TextTransparency = 1
JoinText.ZIndex = 3
JoinText.Parent = MainFrame

-- Кнопка Discord (Y=260, высота 50, отступы по бокам)
local DiscordBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
DiscordBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 50)
DiscordBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 260)
DiscordBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
DiscordBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
DiscordBtn.Text = "💬  Follow My Discord"
DiscordBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DiscordBtn.TextSize = 16
DiscordBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
DiscordBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
DiscordBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
DiscordBtn.TextTransparency = 1
DiscordBtn.ZIndex = 3
DiscordBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local DiscordBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
DiscordBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
DiscordBtnCorner.Parent = DiscordBtn

-- Ссылка мелким текстом под кнопкой (Y=320, высота 16)
local LinkText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LinkText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 16)
LinkText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 320)
LinkText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LinkText.Text = "discord.gg/ZJWwKbz8c"
LinkText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 125, 255)
LinkText.TextSize = 12
LinkText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
LinkText.TextTransparency = 1
LinkText.ZIndex = 3
LinkText.Parent = MainFrame

-- Ховер эффект
DiscordBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(DiscordBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 125, 255)
    }):Play()
end)

DiscordBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(DiscordBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
    }):Play()
end)

DiscordBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    openDiscord()
    TweenService:Create(DiscordBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 200)
    }):Play()
    task.wait(0.15)
    TweenService:Create(DiscordBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
    }):Play()
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 4. АНИМАЦИЯ ПОЯВЛЕНИЯ
-- ============================================================
local function tween(obj, time, props)
    TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

tween(Backdrop, 0.4, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.35})
tween(MainFrame, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
tween(MainStroke, 0.5, {Transparency = 0})
task.wait(0.15)
tween(Title, 0.4, {TextTransparency = 0})
tween(SubTitle, 0.4, {TextTransparency = 0})
tween(Divider1, 0.4, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
tween(ProgressBg, 0.4, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
task.wait(0.2)
tween(StatusText, 0.4, {TextTransparency = 0})
tween(PercentText, 0.4, {TextTransparency = 0})
tween(Divider2, 0.4, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
task.wait(0.1)
tween(JoinText, 0.4, {TextTransparency = 0})
tween(DiscordBtn, 0.4, {BackgroundTransparency = 0, TextTransparency = 0})
tween(LinkText, 0.4, {TextTransparency = 0})

-- ============================================================
-- 5. ИМИТАЦИЯ ЗАГРУЗКИ
-- ============================================================
local loadSteps = {
    {text = "Проверка античита...", time = 0.5},
    {text = "Обход WalkSpeed...", time = 0.4},
    {text = "Обход JumpPower...", time = 0.4},
    {text = "Инициализация Physics...", time = 0.5},
    {text = "Внедрение BodyVelocity...", time = 0.4},
    {text = "Захват NetworkOwner...", time = 0.5},
    {text = "Готово! ✅", time = 0.8},
}

task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(1)
    local total = #loadSteps
    for i, step in ipairs(loadSteps) do
        StatusText.Text = step.text
        local targetSize = UDim2.new(i / total, 0, 1, 0)
        TweenService:Create(ProgressFill, TweenInfo.new(step.time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
            Size = targetSize
        }):Play()
        PercentText.Text = math.floor((i / total) * 100) .. "%"
        task.wait(step.time)
    end
    
    task.wait(0.5)
    tween(Backdrop, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    tween(MainFrame, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.55, 0)})
    tween(MainStroke, 0.5, {Transparency = 1})
    tween(Title, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})
    tween(SubTitle, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})
    tween(Divider1, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    tween(Divider2, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    tween(StatusText, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})
    tween(PercentText, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})
    tween(JoinText, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})
    tween(DiscordBtn, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1})
    tween(LinkText, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})
    tween(ProgressBg, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    tween(ProgressFill, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    
    task.wait(0.7)
    LoadingGui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 6. FLY СИСТЕМА
-- ============================================================
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local RootPart = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local FlyEnabled = false
local FlySpeed = 60
local flyConn, bodyVelocity, bodyGyro
local savedStates = {}

local function applyBypass()
    pcall(function()
        Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
    end)
    savedStates.WalkSpeed = Humanoid.WalkSpeed
    savedStates.JumpPower = Humanoid.JumpPower
    savedStates.UseJumpPower = Humanoid.UseJumpPower
    pcall(function()
        Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
        Humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
    end)
    pcall(function()
        for _, part in pairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer)
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, false)
    end)
end

local function restoreStates()
    pcall(function()
        if savedStates.WalkSpeed then Humanoid.WalkSpeed = savedStates.WalkSpeed end
        if savedStates.JumpPower then
            Humanoid.JumpPower = savedStates.JumpPower
            Humanoid.UseJumpPower = savedStates.UseJumpPower
        end
        Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end)
end

local function startFly()
    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() end
    applyBypass()
    
    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Name = "FlyVelocity"
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bodyVelocity.P = 1250
    bodyVelocity.Parent = RootPart
    
    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.Name = "FlyGyro"
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.D = 500
    bodyGyro.CFrame = RootPart.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = RootPart
    
    flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not FlyEnabled then return end
        if not RootPart or not RootPart.Parent then return end
        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        
        local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDir = moveDir * 2
        end
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            moveDir = moveDir.Unit
        end
        
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDir * FlySpeed
        bodyGyro.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
        
        pcall(function()
            if Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics then
                Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end
    restoreStates()
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    Character = newChar
    Humanoid = newChar:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    RootPart = newChar:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    task.wait(1)
    if FlyEnabled then startFly() end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 7. ПАНЕЛЬ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ (АККУРАТНАЯ)
-- ============================================================
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(5)
    
    local ControlGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    ControlGui.Name = "FlyControl_" .. tostring(math.random(1, 999999))
    ControlGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    ControlGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    pcall(function() ControlGui.Parent = CoreGui end)
    if not ControlGui.Parent then
        ControlGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end
    
    -- Главная панель (высота 220 для всего с отступами)
    local Panel = Instance.new("Frame")
    Panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 220)
    Panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -110)
    Panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
    Panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
    Panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Panel.Active = true
    Panel.Draggable = true
    Panel.Parent = ControlGui
    
    local PCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    PCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
    PCorner.Parent = Panel
    
    local PStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    PStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
    PStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    PStroke.Parent = Panel
    
    -- Заголовок
    local PTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    PTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 30)
    PTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
    PTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    PTitle.Text = "🕊️ FLY MENU"
    PTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    PTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    PTitle.TextSize = 16
    PTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    PTitle.Parent = Panel
    
    -- Разделитель под заголовком (Y=50)
    local PDiv1 = Instance.new("Frame")
    PDiv1.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1)
    PDiv1.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 50)
    PDiv1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
    PDiv1.BorderSizePixel = 0
    PDiv1.Parent = Panel
    
    -- Кнопка FLY ON/OFF (Y=65, высота 38)
    local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 38)
    ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 65)
    ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 72)
    ToggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ToggleBtn.Text = "FLY: OFF"
    ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    ToggleBtn.TextSize = 15
    ToggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    ToggleBtn.Parent = Panel
    
    local TCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    TCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    TCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn
    
    ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        FlyEnabled = not FlyEnabled
        if FlyEnabled then
            startFly()
            ToggleBtn.Text = "FLY: ON"
            TweenService:Create(ToggleBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
            }):Play()
        else
            stopFly()
            ToggleBtn.Text = "FLY: OFF"
            TweenService:Create(ToggleBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 72)
            }):Play()
        end
    end)
    
    -- Разделитель (Y=118)
    local PDiv2 = Instance.new("Frame")
    PDiv2.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1)
    PDiv2.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 118)
    PDiv2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
    PDiv2.BorderSizePixel = 0
    PDiv2.Parent = Panel
    
    -- Лейбл скорости (Y=130)
    local SpeedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    SpeedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
    SpeedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 130)
    SpeedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    SpeedLabel.Text = "Скорость: 60"
    SpeedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
    SpeedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    SpeedLabel.TextSize = 13
    SpeedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    SpeedLabel.Parent = Panel
    
    -- Полоса скорости (Y=158)
    local SpeedBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    SpeedBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 6)
    SpeedBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 158)
    SpeedBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 48)
    SpeedBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    SpeedBar.Parent = Panel
    
    local SBCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    SBCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    SBCorner.Parent = SpeedBar
    
    local SpeedFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    SpeedFill.Size = UDim2.new(0.14, 0, 1, 0) -- 60/300 = 0.2, но диапазон 20-300 = 0.14
    SpeedFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
    SpeedFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    SpeedFill.Parent = SpeedBar
    
    local SFCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    SFCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    SFCorner.Parent = SpeedFill
    
    -- Невидимая кликабельная зона для слайдера (чуть больше полосы)
    local SpeedBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    SpeedBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 20)
    SpeedBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 151)
    SpeedBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    SpeedBtn.Text = ""
    SpeedBtn.Parent = Panel
    
    local dragging = false
    local function updateSpeed(input)
        local relX = math.clamp((input.Position.X - SpeedBar.AbsolutePosition.X) / SpeedBar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local newSpeed = math.floor(20 + relX * 280)
        FlySpeed = newSpeed
        SpeedFill.Size = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1, 0)
        SpeedLabel.Text = "Скорость: " .. newSpeed
    end
    
    SpeedBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            updateSpeed(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateSpeed(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    
    -- Разделитель (Y=182)
